biography.plain_text: Alain Zagury is a French entrepreneur who built a substantial mobile-phone distribution business. Born in Rehovot, Israel, he developed shops installing telecommunications equipment in vehicles before founding Accessoires Télécom Services in 1996. He later became a major ModeLabs shareholder, heading its French distribution subsidiary and chairing the group’s supervisory board.

long_biography.plain_text:
Alain Zagury helped launch Next Mobiles with a rental offer for new and refurbished smartphones. Customers could pay monthly, with insurance included, and exchange a handset for its successor without increasing the subscription price. The venture combined his distribution experience with colleagues from phone sales and mobile-network services.

His earlier work on the combination of ModeLabs and Bigben extended beyond a board seat. Through his company Parcours Invest, he advised on sourcing, information systems and comparisons of commercial practices. The assignment also covered future product lines and market trends, giving the combined group access to his experience in bringing mobile products to market.
